citation: Creamer, Winifred; Ruiz, Alvaro; Haas, Jonathan. 2007. Archaeological Investigation of Late Archaic Sites (3000–1800 B.C.) in the Pativilca Valley, Peru. Fieldiana Anthropology n.s. 40: 1–78. Field Museum of Natural History, Chicago. DOI 10.3158/0071-4739(2007)189[1:AIOLAS]2.0.CO;2.
notes: Fieldiana Anthropology field report (n.s. 40). Testing at nine Pativilca Valley sites; 44 radiocarbon samples from eight sites; seven occupied ~2740–1870 cal BCE (Late Archaic); Potao sample ~1480 cal BCE (Initial Period). First systematically collected dates for this valley within Norte Chico. Tier P (project excavation/testing report).
